note: Staging objectives. They become a production commitment only when engineering, operations, security and product owners sign the acceptance record for a SHA that is actually deployed to staging.

signals.sli: Share of /auth/* responses with HTTP status below 500.
Share of POST /agent/search responses with HTTP status below 500, plus latency.
signals.objective: 99.5% non-5xx. API target p95 under 750 ms. Hybrid retrieval p95 and p99 under 200 ms stays an open finding until a production-shaped run meets it.
signals.alarm: 5 server errors in 5 minutes. Latency uses the existing API target p95 alarm at 750 ms.

signals.sli: Share of POST /agent/rates/recheck responses with HTTP status below 500.
signals.objective: 99% non-5xx. A supplier-declared unavailable or price change returned as HTTP 200 is success. A catch block must not substitute stale or zero-priced inventory.

signals.sli: Share of POST /agent/bookings responses with HTTP status below 500.
signals.objective: 99.9% non-5xx. An idempotent replay is success. An unknown supplier outcome stays pending investigation.

signals.sli: Share of DELETE /agent/bookings/:id responses with HTTP status below 500.
Count of HTTP 401 and 403 responses outside /auth/*.
signals.objective: A denial storm is investigated. A single 403 is expected RBAC.

signals.sli: Supplier fan-out failure ratio on supplier.search spans.
signals.objective: Page when one connector's failure ratio exceeds 5% for 15 minutes. Failures stay visible.
signals.alarm: Not a CloudWatch metric until the ADOT collector is confirmed in staging (ADR 0093).
Existing search-reindex and compliance heartbeat alarms. Missing data breaches.
